app.name: WC04 Camera (experimental)
app.long_description: Diagnostic UVC photo capture build for the 057e:030a WC04 camera. Requires IOS58 and writable SD. A captures, 1 selects 320x240 or 640x480, 2 scans, HOME exits. Adds timestamped logs, explicit capture-stop reasons, and packet diagnostics. Discovery and stream activation have been reported on Wii; successful photo capture remains unverified. No live viewfinder. If cancellation waits for USB, unplug the camera to release the transfer.
